before.question: A disclosure has open="false". Why does it still start expanded?
choices: false is a forbidden word everywhere in HTML
open is Boolean: its presence enables it
before.explanation: Boolean attributes are enabled by presence. Remove open altogether to start the disclosure closed.

after.question: Why does details with open="false" still start expanded?
choices: The word false is forbidden in HTML.
The presence of open turns it on.
after.explanation: `open` is switched on by being present. Remove the attribute to start closed.
